profile.status: Open to full-time roles and freelance projects

built: Migrated the account service from PHP to FastAPI while preserving the JSON response contract and frontend compatibility. Kept the initial migration separate from subsequent refactoring.

Fixed bugs with different root causes (code, browser, extensions) across several microservices: reproducing the issue first, tracing it to its root cause, and only then weighing a few solutions before applying the right one.
Built a configurable tabs component with three design variants integrated into a single component, with GSAP hover animations, following the Figma specs.
4thewords.learned: I learned not to delete code just because it looks useless at first glance. Sometimes it's a quiet patch holding something important together, and you need to understand what it's solving before touching it.

built: Built new backend features in Django for an English-teaching platform.
Worked with the team on the database and backend logic for a student rewards and gamification system.
Worked with the frontend team to correctly integrate the new endpoints into the student experience.
funread.learned: It was my first real experience, and I learned more than I expected: how a gamified system actually works from the ground up, how to build that whole feature (from the database to the backend) without breaking anything that already existed, and also how to work as a team and document properly — things no course teaches quite the same way.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This site is my personal portfolio. This page explains what information is collected when you visit it and how I use it.

sections.heading: What data is collected
sections.body: I use Google Analytics to understand how this site is used: which pages are visited, how much time is spent on each, what country or device you're browsing from, and where you came from (e.g. LinkedIn or Google). I don't collect your name, email, or any directly identifying information, unless you send it to me yourself through the contact form.

sections.heading: How this information is used
sections.body: I use this data only to understand what content is useful and to improve the site. I don't sell, share, or transfer this information to third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Contact form
sections.body: If you fill out the contact form, the name, email, and message you send are used exclusively to reply to you. They are not added to any mailing list or used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses a technical cookie to remember your choice about Analytics (accept or reject), and Google Analytics' own cookies if you gave your consent. You can change your decision at any time from the "cookie preferences" link in the footer.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask me at any time to confirm what data I have about you (usually none beyond what you've written in the contact form) or to delete it, by writing to hola@gerardomartinez.dev.
